question: What daily recitation practice is prescribed while meditating on the deity delighting in rāsa play?
premises: The practitioner visualizes the deity delighting in rāsa play.
The recitation is to be done daily.
The prescribed count is one thousand.
inference: One should daily meditate on the deity delighting in rāsa play and recite the mantra one thousand times.
plain_english: Meditating on the deity delighting in the rāsa play, one should recite the mantra one thousand times every day.
